_README: Q154: rebuild of the female VH torso-CT DICOM-to-atlas-frame calibration, lost with an earlier container reset.

Two independent pieces, kept separate: (1) the CT DICOM series -> torso-RAS frame (exact, re-derived from the raw DICOM header geometry, verified to 0.000mm against the already-shipped data/ct_sources/task_outputs/vhf_arm_bones_ct.nii.gz); (2) the cryosection-series-z -> torso-RAS offset (a real, measured calibration, not exact -- see rmse_mm).
source: U.S. National Library of Medicine, The Visible Human Project (public domain), female 'Normal' CT via the NCI Imaging Data Commons.

ct_frame.method: scripts/inspect_dicom_series.py (real DICOM ImagePositionPatient/PixelSpacing) -> scripts/stack_dicom_series.py (physical-coordinate stack, LPS->RAS).
ct_frame.note: affine[0,3]=240.0, affine[1,3]=240.0, affine[2,3]=-1022.0 (torso-RAS z at voxel k=0) -- read directly from the freshly re-downloaded DICOM headers, reproducing the exact same 3 constants baked into the already-shipped data/ct_sources/task_outputs/vhf_arm_bones_ct.nii.gz's own affine without being told them in advance.
ct_frame.atlas_origin_source: docs/GEOMETRY_SOURCES.md (Q9, femoral-head sphere fit, unchanged by this task).

verification.method: Re-ran scripts/vhf_arm_bones_ct.py unmodified against the freshly re-stacked CT (same scratchpad paths the script already expects) and compared its right radius/ulna masks voxel-for-voxel against the already-committed data/ct_sources/task_outputs/vhf_arm_bones_ct.nii.gz.
verification.result: EXACT reproduction (IoU 1.0, 0.000mm centroid difference on both bones) -- well inside the ≤1mm bar.

cryo_forearm_hand_frame.method: Q151's re-acquired forearm/hand cryosection photographs (scratchpad vh_cryo_f_forearm_q151/vh_cryo_f_hand_q151) carry a real per-instance z in the cryo series' OWN local coordinate (cryo_index.json col 3; NOT the torso-CT frame). Calibrated the offset between that coordinate and torso-RAS z by matching a real, independent shape signal at every level in both series: the radius-ulna cross-section centroid-to-centroid separation distance. CT profile: scripts/vhf_arm_bones_ct.py's own reproduced radius_r/ulna_r masks, per-z-slice centroid separation (data/ct_sources/task_outputs/vhf_arm_bones_ct.nii.gz labels 1/2). Photograph profile: cryo_classes_f.classify + the same clean_candidate/bone-disc-blob logic scripts/transfer/refine_transfer_photo_watershed.py uses for the male, per real photograph (every 4th of the 511 forearm levels, cropped to the photo-left half where the subject's own right forearm always falls). Fit: least-squares grid search of a pure additive offset (both series are 1:1 mm scale, same proximal->distal sign convention, confirmed by inspection) over cryo_z + OFFSET vs torso-RAS z, minimizing RMSE between the two separation-distance profiles.
cryo_forearm_hand_frame.note: Single, clean global minimum over the full plausible search range (no other competing offset within 50mm error at any other 50mm-spaced probe point) -- not a fit forced to a local optimum. This is a real, imperfect calibration (4.4mm rmse on a photograph-derived blob centroid signal), unlike the CT frame above which is exact; used only for the forearm/hand photograph registration in Q154 step 3, disclosed at that precision.
